simple.meaning: גֶּנֶז (genez) is a Hebrew word meaning “treasure ; by implication, a coffer.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גֶּנֶז (H1595) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Esther 3:9, with occurrences in Esther, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֶּנֶז (H1595) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גֶּנֶז (H1595) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גֶּנֶז (genez) / H1595 is traced through Esther 3:9, Esther 4:7, Ezekiel 27:24 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: If it pleases the king, let it be written that they be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents* A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces of silver into the hands of those who are in charge of the king’s business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.”

definitions.full: H1595. genez [ גְּנָזִים ] noun [masculine] plural 1 chests (?); 2 treasury — only plural construct גִּנְזֵי ; — 1 perhaps chests of variegated cloth ׳ג בְּרֹמִים Ezek 27:24 so Thes AV RV; Sm Co and others cloths, carpets , Ew Taschen . 2 treasury (Late Hebrew גֶּנֶז , Aramaic גְּנִיז גִּנְזָא, , Biblical Aramaic construct plural גִּנְזֵי ; Persian loan-word from treasure ? compare Vullers ii.1032 Lag Ges.Abh.27 ); הַמֶּלֶךְ גִּנְזֵי Est 3:9 ; 4:7 . [ גְּנַז ] noun masculine Ezra 6:1 treasure ( ᵑ7 ; see Biblical Hebrew [ גְּנָזִים ], below גנז ); — plural emphatic גִּנְזִיָּא treasures 6:1 , ׳ג בֵּית מַלְכָּא דִּי 5:17 , construct מִלְכָּא גִּנְזֵי בֵּית 7:20 .
